headline: 本周影剧：爱情假说领跑，女巫团学院首播
summary: 本周电影热作包括《爱情假说》《野兽之心》等；新剧《女巫团学院》《装备我最强》首播，热播剧《龙族》《菜鸟老警》持续吸睛，待映片《复仇者联盟5》受关注。

industryHighlights.text: 电影热作：《爱情假说》《野兽之心》等本周领跑。
industryHighlights.en: Movie highlights: The Love Hypothesis and Heart of the Beast lead this week.

industryHighlights.text: 新剧首播：《女巫团学院》《装备我最强》开播。
industryHighlights.en: New series: Witch Academy and Equipment Master premiere.

industryHighlights.text: 热播剧：《菜鸟老警》《瑞克和莫蒂》《龙族》持续吸睛。
industryHighlights.en: On-air dramas: The Rookie, Rick and Morty, and House of the Dragon remain buzzworthy.

industryHighlights.text: 待映待播：《复仇者联盟5》《幻视任务》等受期待。
industryHighlights.en: Upcoming: Avengers 5 and Vision Quest draw anticipation.

headlineEn: This Week: Love Hypothesis Leads, Witch Academy Debuts
summaryEn: This week's movie highlights include The Love Hypothesis and Heart of the Beast; new series Witch Academy and Equipment Master premiere, while House of the Dragon and The Rookie stay popular, and Avengers 5 is upcoming.
